fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects potential processes activity of RemoteView RMM tool
fields.name: Potential RemoteView RMM Tool Process Activity
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((src.process.image.path contains "remoteview.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "rv.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "rvagent.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "rvagtray.exe") or (tgt.process.image.path contains "remoteview.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "rv.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "rvagent.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "rvagtray.exe")))
